'''Earth Wave''' is an [[Earth spells|earth]]-based [[Wave spells|wave spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 70 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the second-strongest earth spell in the game, with the strongest being [[Earth Surge]].

==Damage==
Earth Wave's base maximum hit starts at 19 and increases to 20 once the player unlocks [[Fire Wave]] at level 75 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Earth Wave's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As an earth-based spell, Earth Wave's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to earth]].
